card.name: Units and measuring words after quantities
card.fires_on: Unit words (years, feet, cm, -hour) right after a number, and words like measured or defined that describe how a quantity is measured. Seen in dose spacing, distances and durations.

modes.label: Unit after number
modes.description: A unit of time or length directly follows a number.
modes.example: should be spaced approximately 1<< cm>> apart (see Figure 1 )

modes.label: Hour intervals
modes.description: The hyphenated -hour after a number in dosing interval phrases.
modes.example: administered in divided doses at 6<<-hour>> intervals

modes.label: Measured from
modes.description: The word measured or a similar word describing how a distance or angle is taken.
modes.example: considered as a point,<< measured>> from

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about measuring and counting, such as measured and counted.
card.plain: It fires on units after numbers and on the word measured, where text says how something is measured.
